claims.value: Trinity Nano Preview W4A16 is a preview of Arcee AI's 6B MoE model with 1B active parameters. It is the small-sized model in the Trinity family, an open-weight model for enterprise and tinkerers. This is a chat tuned model. It contains W4A16 quantized weights (INT4 weights, 16-bit activations). It is trained on 10T tokens.
